digest.component_or_area: binding recovery and retirement completion at reconcile boundary
propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement creates a detectable partial state with same identity in both live and retired, which must be safely completed at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary
Recovery must remove the redundant live forward/reverse pair only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities agree exactly; mismatch or corruption must safety-abort without mutation

Pre-observation retirement completion must execute after the under-lock staleness gate in reconcile._load_snapshots but before any remote issue fetch, construction, dry-run, preview, or filtered operations must remain zero-write

A durable tombstone is the authoritative retirement intent; later automatic 200/clear_absent/same-key confirm does not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity, only explicit unretire removes the intent
The production rich-text handler must be cut to use the narrow facade operation instead of mutating a binding obtained from all_bindings()
Keyed pending recovery performs no search; keyless pending requires both three misses and 3600-second conjunction before unbind, with per-entry failures remaining loud and nonfatal
